# AI Attribution Instructions

## Rule: Always Add AI Attribution Comments

Every piece of AI-generated or AI-modified code must be tagged with an attribution comment. This is mandatory for auditability, accountability, and consistency across all Paycor teams and repositories.

### When Creating a New File

Add the following comment near the top of the file (after any imports/headers):

```
// Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY
```

Use the **current date** in MM/DD/YYYY format.

### When Modifying an Existing File

Add or update an attribution comment at the location of the change:

```
// Modified by AI on MM/DD/YYYY. Edit #1.
```

For subsequent edits to the same file, increment the edit number:

```
// Modified by AI on MM/DD/YYYY. Edit #2.
// Modified by AI on MM/DD/YYYY. Edit #3.
```

### Comment Syntax by Language

| Language | Comment Style |
|---|---|
| TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Java, Go, Swift, Kotlin, Rust | `// Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY` |
| Python, Ruby, Shell, YAML | `# Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY` |
| HTML, XML | `<!-- Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY -->` |
| CSS, SCSS | `/* Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY */` |
| SQL | `-- Generated by AI on MM/DD/YYYY` |

### Rules

- **Always** include the attribution comment when generating or modifying code.
- Use the **current date** at the time of generation/modification.
- Place the comment **near the top** of new files or **adjacent to the modified section** for edits.
- Do **not** remove existing attribution comments from prior edits.
- Increment the edit number for each subsequent AI modification to the same file.
